relationships.subject: HSP90
relationships.evidence_quote: HSP90 in the spinal cord may be a co-stimulatory molecule for EA induced relief of neuropathic pain by regulating TLR4.

key_findings: Electroacupuncture relieved thermal hyperalgesia in CCI rats, lowered spinal IL-1β and TNF-α and reduced microglial TLR4
HSP90 inhibition with geldanamycin reduced TLR4 and HSP90 expression, suggesting HSP90 as co-stimulatory molecule for TLR4
